question: Does the EvoEF2 fixed-backbone verdict (BLOSUM62 argmax > ESM3 > paired random on ddG) survive a flexible-side-chain force field (FoldX 5.1) on the same positions and arms?

design.structure: oprm1_R.pdb chain R (8EFO lineage), RepairPDB per FoldX protocol
design.lists_reused_from: ddg_work/list_{esm3,blosum62,matched}.txt (byte-identical arm design, position-matched, 720/720 lines validated against repaired PDB: WT residue and chain R correct at every position)

pre_registered_statistics.note: 720 rows collapse to 133 unique (position,wt) triples via last-occurrence rule (dict overwrite in analyze_ddg_foldx_3arm.py). Positions with multiple lines are NOT redundant computations: they carry multiple DISTINCT mutation suggestions at the same position (esm3: 29 positions, matched: 70; blosum62 argmax: 0). The paired test compares each method's suggested mutation ddG at each position. All tests use n=133.
pre_registered_statistics.primary_test: two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank on position-matched arms, alpha=0.05
pre_registered_statistics.primary_comparison: ESM3 vs BLOSUM62 (the EvoEF2 verdict axis)
pre_registered_statistics.robustness: repeat all tests with |ddG|<=10 kcal/mol trimming (pre-registered, mirrors EvoEF2 analysis)
pre_registered_statistics.multiple_comparisons: Holm correction across the 3 paired comparisons
pre_registered_statistics.foldx_noise_floor: self-mutation floor measured in smoke test: mean -0.0112, max |ddG| 0.0509 (5 self-mutations); medians below 0.05 kcal/mol are indistinguishable from FoldX self-repack noise

falsification_criteria.hypothesis_H1_confirms_evoef2: ESM3 does not beat BLOSUM62 under FoldX either (paired Wilcoxon n=133 p>0.05 in ESM3's favor) -> the EvoEF2 negative verdict is force-field-robust on the flexible-side-chain axis; strengthens CIERRE.
falsification_criteria.hypothesis_H2_reversal: ESM3 beats BLOSUM62 under FoldX (p<0.05, rank-biserial r>0.3) -> the EvoEF2 verdict was an artifact of fixed-backbone scoring; the line re-opens as PIVOTE with a real finding.
falsification_criteria.hypothesis_H3_inconclusive: sign flip without significance or floor-confounded medians -> declared INCONCLUSIVE, no narrative either way.

kill_criteria: If >20% of mutations in any arm fail to produce a ddG value, stop and report coverage defect before any statistics.
If any self-mutation control in this battery returns |ddG|>0.5 kcal/mol, flag FoldX state inconsistency and re-validate the tool before interpreting.
Optional stopping PROHIBITED: full 240-per-arm run completes before any test is computed.
what_this_experiment_CANNOT_conclude: Nothing about fibromyalgia (framing removed in parent line).
Nothing about OPRM1 as a drug target.
Nothing about binding affinity (Vina remains conditional on a positive ddG result).
FoldX ddG absolute values are not comparable to EvoEF2 absolute values; only paired rank/statistics within FoldX.
This is not experimental ddG; both force fields are approximations.

execution.outputs: ddg.tsv per arm + full logs, copied to experiments/ddg_foldx_work/ on completion
